episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses innovative strategies for leveraging past clients and existing properties to generate new business and investment opportunities. He covers turning homes into rental properties, utilizing bridge loans to buy before selling, and using HELOCs to access equity. The episode also highlights how AI is streamlining the loan process, offering agents and clients new ways to navigate the real estate market.
